capabilities: Download tweets and threads from a URL as Markdown notes
Save tweet images and assets locally
Customize filenames and save paths with template variables
Generate frontmatter with tweet metadata and custom tags
Convert pasted Twitter links into embedded tweet content
extras: The free TTM API key option is marked disabled; since April 27, 2023 users must supply their own Twitter bearer token, and the Free Twitter plan is insufficient (at least Basic is needed). Gifs and videos cannot be downloaded via the v2 API.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture tweets or tweet threads as local Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: If you are also using the Auto Link Title plugin, you may see that it picks up the pasted link first

requires.name: TTM API key or Twitter Developer bearer token
Twitter Developer dashboard account (Basic plan for tweet lookup)

summary: Twitter downloader that saves tweets and threads as Markdown notes with frontmatter, images, polls, and links.
